_doc: Hand-made clearings on the Southern Mountain Range (smr_merge.py). 'boxes': a rectangle [x0, y0, x1, y1] (upper-left and bottom-right corners) drawn as one dirt clearing; every connection with BOTH ends inside it is not drawn (with 'faint_paths' they are drawn very lightly instead; with 'rough_marks' crags and boulders are scattered between them). 'add_rooms': {'room': id, 'to': a room (or rooms) already in the clearing it joins, 'mode': 'stem' (default: the room's square plus a band to the nearest part of that clearing) or 'hull' (everything between the room and the 'to' rooms is filled)}; a bare number joins the nearest clearing. Hidden rooms may be named. 'climbs': a rocky path up a mountain through the four rooms [a, b, c, d] (corners in order); the thin lines between those rooms are not drawn. Every thin path stops at the edge of a clearing it runs into (smr_merge.py).
